newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea Dainong Group shares up on hopes for loans.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Dainong Group shares up on hopes for loans.

text.p: Shares in South Korea's Dainong Group went limit up in Wednesday's morning trading in the belief domestic financial institutions would soon extend fresh loans, brokers said.
Dainong Corp rose 250 won to 3,410 at 0100 GMT and Midopa Department Store added 660 won to 9,030.
The group has requested 78 billion won in rescue loans.
An official at SEOULBANK, Daining's primary lender, said a decision on the loan would be made in a meeting of representatives of financial institutions scheduled for this afternoon.
A Coryo Securities broker said investors believed the two companies would be bailed out.
"They also believed Dainong's recent self-rescue plan would pay off."
The group has said it would raise 640 billion won by selling affiliates and real estate. The group has 21 affiliates.
